wins: Completed full perimeter reconnaissance, capturing all live hosts and ports within the limited episode.
Captured detailed service banner data that can seed targeted exploitation strategies.
fails: Could not progress past the initial foothold since privilege escalation artifacts were unavailable and the exploit attempts timed out.
Mentor was required 15 times, indicating repeated stalls in decision-making during exploitation phase.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough, but exploitation stalled before any foothold could be escalated; next runs need more effective credential collection or brute force tactics.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts routinely failed due to missing sudoers write access and no stored credentials for later use.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 is open and HTTP service responds with headers
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nikto and gobuster scans to enumerate directories and backend technologies

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB (port 445) is open with anonymous login allowed
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate shares and pull smbclient anonymous listings for credential harvesting

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 open but brute-force access unknown
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger nmap ssh enumeration scripts and store banner metadata for future cracking attempts

memory_ops.reason: Consistently successful in extracting actionable web recon data despite overall run failure.
SMB enumeration produced share listings that could inform future credential discovery.

next_experiments.title: Focused SMB credential harvesting
next_experiments.description: After capture of anonymous shares, immediately run impacket-secretsdump and enum4linux to extract credentials before escalating.

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation via local misconfig claims
next_experiments.description: Test linpeas and sudo enumeration for every accessible user to detect misconfigurations that can be chained.
